positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
OS platform team; working across various core low-level technologies: Windows kernel, HAL, ACPI, PCI, Hyper-V, and Azure Compute Host.

Working closely with industry silicon partners (Intel, AMD, ARM, Qualcomm, NVIDIA...) and OEMs, shipping Windows on IoT, client PCs, server, and the cloud.

A lot of my earlier projects have been focused on getting Windows and Windows Phone to run great on ARM(64). These days, I'm focused on Azure Compute infrastructure.

As "side-gigs", I'm serving as Windows API reviewer; at some point in the past, I was a program instructor for Windows Internals training program.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Windows kernel: interrupt handling on ARM, improving power efficiency & performance.

Eventually filed a patent on this intern project (US9424212B2).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Front-end development on the YouTube team.

I didn't actually work on YouTube; there was a video platform that never saw the light of day.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Business intelligence application development. Worked as a co-op during May-August 2009, January-April 2010.

positions.title: Software Test Developer
positions.description:
Test automation for enterprise reporting tools (Crystal Reports).

I wrote an automated test framework based on Selenium for testing Adobe Flex applications.

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description: Manual and automated user interface testing of web applications used for monitoring datacenters.

patents.title: Operating System-Managed Interrupt Steering in Multiprocessor Systems
